title: Puff Puff Paint Northern Lights BLACKLIGHT PARTY
seo_title: Puff Puff Paint Northern Lights Blacklight Party, Joplin
description: Puff Puff Paint Northern Lights BLACKLIGHT PARTY is a 420-friendly paint class where you make a blacklight glow painting of the northern lights, or pick a blank canvas and create your own design. Each ticket comes with a gift from sponsor @The Move. Community, and food from Tooth Fairy Sweets & Eats is available on site but not included in the ticket price. It takes place on November 21, 2026 (Time TBD) at 214 E. 12th St in Joplin, MO, and cash and Cashapp are accepted.
address: 214 E 12th St, Joplin, MO 64801-4646, United States, Joplin, MO
